results.rationale: Consistency: the green/red pack and white background remain, but tray proportions shift and label lettering on many stationary cans and the tray is changed or corrupted. Instruction: the separate right can has been removed from its original position and is visibly lying on top of the boxed cans, satisfying the requested placement. Quality: widespread garbled branding and warped fine label details across the pack create multiple distracting artifacts.

Consistency: both white cups and saucers remain on the same surface, but the large right cup changes size/position and bean arrangements and shadows change. Instruction: the left cup remains clearly smaller; the size mismatch persists rather than the small cup being enlarged to match. Quality: cup rims, handles, beans and soft shadows are coherent and natural, with no conspicuous structural artifacts.
